palette.notes: Measured palette_size 12 at native 288x512 (2x scale), one ramp with hue shift ~56 over 11 colours. Greens go to teal-blue in shadow and yellow-green in light; the console and controller are purples; small red and yellow flowers as accents on a dark teal background.

lighting: Soft top-left light: highlights on the TV and console tops, shaded right sides; the dark teal backdrop isolates the diorama.
silhouette: Isometric island vignette: old CRT TV and a GameCube overgrown with plants, readable as one rounded blob against the empty background.

motion.timing: Measured 7 changes over 8.34 s, median hold 400 ms (p25 262.5, p75 500): a slow screen animation where a symbol is drawn stroke by stroke on the TV, then a white flash with scanlines (~5.9-6.6 s), then the screen goes dark. The rest is still.

texture: Clean pixel clusters, almost no dithering (dither_share 0.0004); foliage built from leaf-shaped clusters with highlight dots.
camera: Static, isometric 3/4 view; the scene floats centred with lots of empty space above and below.

acting.acts: No characters: the 'actor' is the TV screen, which boots up a logo in slow steps, flashes white and goes off, like a ghost of an old console.
acting.exits: The screen turns off after the flash.
acting.depth: Single isometric diorama; the whole scene is the object, set in an empty void.

techniques: isometric overgrown-object diorama on a flat dark background
hue-shifted green ramp (~56 degrees): teal shadows, yellow-green lights
only one element animates (the TV screen), with 260-500 ms holds
stepped logo build then a white flash with scanlines as the payoff
purple props against green foliage for colour contrast
feel: dark empty void + small cozy overgrown diorama + one slow-animating screen = nostalgic, calm loop
for_fred: Animate only one thing at a time: let Fred's scene hold still while a single prop (a screen, a bubble) changes on slow 260-500 ms holds, then pay off with one flash; avoids the overused-animation problem.
